content.what_it_is: MATLAB NTHMP benchmark-04 comparator. It accepts H=0.0185 and H=0.30 model-result filenames (L1), dynamically loads their matrices plus SW_01_00185.mat and SW_01_03.mat (L161-L200), builds a 1:19.85 beach line (L210-L212), computes interpolation-based NRMSD and maximum-amplitude error for five first-case snapshots (L214-L471) and four second-case snapshots (L473-L692), and renders 5-panel and 4-panel comparison figures.

unresolved: Use-before-supplied interface defect across L166 and L184: a one-argument call enters the else branch and evaluates isempty(filename2) even though filename2 was not supplied.

Filename/interface mismatch across L176-L194: load is followed by dot/underscore parsing and eval of the stripped filename as a variable, so paths with directories, multiple dots, or invalid identifier basenames can fail or bind the wrong loaded variable; no loaded-variable validation is done.

Metric-domain inconsistency repeated from L232-L247 onward: interpolation NaNs are replaced by beach elevations and included in NRMSD, while maximum-amplitude error uses only the pre-fill finite set ina, so the two scores cover different model-support domains.
Copy/paste output defect at L401: the t=60 H=0.0185 diagnostic prints leading label 30, unlike the calculation and plot that identify t=60 (L381-L415).

Wrong-interface guard across L517-L527: the H=0.30 t=15 model curve is conditioned on filename2, but its legend is conditioned on filename1. With only filename2 supplied the model curve lacks its label; with only filename1 supplied a nonexistent second-case model is labeled.

Every NRMSD divides by N and analytical range Norm, and every maximum error divides by the analytical maximum, without guards for empty overlap, zero range, or zero maximum (first occurrence L244-L247).
The model arrays are indexed through column 6 for a1 and column 5 for a2 without runtime shape checks; interpolation also assumes monotone, compatible coordinate columns.
